parts.desc: Add-on I/O: COP 3/4, boost, alternator, main relay, knock, VR crank/cam, external AFR, flex-fuel sensor, nitrous arming switch, CAN for gauges, 5 V, +12 V (fused, F4)
USB-C sink CC2
Stock harness header, 76 positions (OEM plugs 1/3/4 used). Hand-solder; salvage from a stock ECU or use a clone
2.54 mm 1x40 female, 8.5 mm. Mates with the daughterboard J1 (power + outputs)
MAP supply
MAP sensor, 15-700 kPa absolute, single barbed port (case 867B). Lies flat, marking up, leads bent 90 deg, 2x M3 screws

NOT FITTED: 12 V pull-up for the A/C switch input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it

NOT FITTED: 12 V pull-up for the vehicle speed input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it
Idle valve freewheel diode (to its +12 V feed, VBAT_IN): keeps the PWM turn-off energy out of the driver
Flex-fuel sensor signal pull-up to 5 V
Resettable fuse for the AUX +12 V pin J5-15 (BHFUSE BSMD1812-110-33V: 1.1 A hold, 2.2 A trip, 33 V, 1812; the daughterboard's F1 is the same part)
USB-C sink CC1
Nitrous arming input pull-down: an open wire reads "not armed"
CAN termination link: fitted = 120R terminator active; remove if the bus is terminated elsewhere
USB-C for tuning and firmware (USB 2.0 FS)
2.54 mm 1x40 female, 8.5 mm. Mates with the daughterboard J2 (inputs + comms)

NOT FITTED: 12 V pull-up for the clutch switch input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the switch closed) only if your car's signal switches to ground or is open collector; a switch that drives 12 V must not have it
Resettable fuse for the LSU heater supply (LUTE 2920L300/30GR: 3 A hold, 5 A trip, 30 V)
Boost valve freewheel diode to the AUX +12 V pin (feed the valve from J5-15)
MAP supply
USB ESD protection
CAN termination

Wideband sensor harness AEM 30-3427 (to a Bosch LSU 4.9). JST PUD side-entry header S08B-PUDSS-1. AEM pin: 1 trim (RT, green), 2 heater - (white), 3 common (VM, orange), 5 pump (IP, red), 6 sense (UN, black), 8 heater + (brown); 4 and 7 empty
MAP output filter
